triggers.condition: A fresh agent enters the repository or operational truth is uncertain.
An existing pull request needs repair, rebasing, rebuilding, validation, merging, or closure.
A registered validator, hook, build, CI job, or workflow step returns non-zero or fails an assertion.
Any file under .ai/, AGENTS.md, AGENT_GUARDRAILS.md, scripts/ai-harness/, server/ai-harness/, or .githooks/ changes.
render.yaml, scripts/production-start.mjs, scripts/deploy/**, scripts/db/**, migrations/**, package.json, or tests/deploy/** changes.
Operator requests a local production certification for a candidate SHA.
A deployment candidate SHA is current on its branch and all required checks pass on the current head.
A deployment-related claim is made without a registered runtime-proof artifact.
A request targets Render, Neon, DNS, or production services without an explicit operator authorization marker.
More than one planned writer, branch, or pull request with potentially overlapping repository ownership.
A task requires classification of reasoning demand and routing to an executor with proven capability evidence.
Account backup/export/import behavior changes or a deployment candidate needs fresh account recovery proof.
A current repository candidate is being considered for deployment and must first determine deployment necessity, remaining gates, and qualitative cost exposure.
The operator intends to promote a release candidate to the production-connected main branch and needs the complete release gate through post-deploy verification.
The operator wants a fresh deploy/no-deploy verdict for the exact current candidate before any live mutation.
A deployment candidate changes dependencies, auth, secrets/env contracts, CI/CD, Render configuration, startup, migrations, or other security-sensitive release surfaces.

Repository and local-runtime gates are current and passing, READY_FOR_AUTHORIZED_DEPLOYMENT is recorded for the exact candidate SHA, and the operator explicitly authorizes the live main-branch promotion.
A production deployment completed or main advanced on the production-connected branch and live health must be verified without mutating production.
